ds4c.pack.effects.name: DS4C Effects
ds4c.pack.effects.desc: DualSense adaptive trigger rules for Controlify
ds4c.config.title: DualSense for Controlify
ds4c.config.trigger_strength.tooltip: Scales the resistance and vibration of DS4C's trigger effects. Lower it if the triggers tire your fingers. Off turns DS4C's trigger effects off; Controlify's own still apply.
ds4c.config.footsteps.tooltip: A light tap for each footstep and small landing, shaped by the ground underfoot. 0 turns them off; bigger falls still thump.
ds4c.config.master_intensity.tooltip: Scales every DS4C grip haptic; 0 turns them off. They need Controlify's HD haptics setting on, and a USB connection (or, on Linux, Bluetooth with the DS4L daemon). Turn Controlify's "Allow Vibrations" off: DS4C plays its own versions of those events, so with both on you feel them twice.
ds4c.config.synthesis_intensity.tooltip: Scales DS4C's generated effects (footsteps, heartbeat, ambient loops) without changing haptics taken from game sounds.
ds4c.config.falloff_near.tooltip: Sounds closer than this many blocks play at full strength.
ds4c.config.falloff_far.tooltip: Sounds fade out by this many blocks. Some sounds have a shorter range of their own.
ds4c.config.group.categories.tooltip: How strong each group's grip haptics are. 0 turns the group off, its trigger effects included.
ds4c.config.category.movement.tooltip: Footsteps, landings, rides, slowing blocks, swimming, fireworks and the elytra.
ds4c.config.category.combat.tooltip: Swings, hits, bows, crossbows, tridents, shields, maces, damage, explosions, the totem and the Warden.
ds4c.config.category.ambient.tooltip: Rain, water, wind, magma, portals, lightning, boss events and nearby bees, conduits and beacons.
ds4c.config.category.items.tooltip: Eating, drinking, fishing, goat horns, the spyglass, compass, clock and item breaks.
ds4c.config.category.environment.tooltip: Mining, placing blocks, buckets, hoes, shears, spawn eggs, doors, chests and levers.
ds4c.config.category.ui.tooltip: Haptics for pickups, level-ups, toasts and workstation results.
ds4c.setup.no_haptics.bluetooth: [DS4C] Your DualSense is on Bluetooth, so its HD haptics can't play. Connect it with a USB cable to feel DS4C's grip haptics.
ds4c.setup.no_haptics.bluetooth_linux: [DS4C] Your DualSense is on Bluetooth and no HD haptics device was found for it. Connect it with a USB cable, or install the DS4L daemon to get HD haptics over Bluetooth. See DS4C's linux-hd-haptics guide.
ds4c.setup.no_haptics.linux: [DS4C] HD haptics aren't available for your DualSense. Check Controlify's HD Haptics option is on and, on Linux, that the controller's audio uses the Pro Audio (or Direct) profile. See DS4C's linux-hd-haptics guide.
ds4c.setup.no_haptics.generic: [DS4C] HD haptics aren't available for your DualSense. Check it's connected by USB and Controlify's HD Haptics option is on.
ds4c.config.pull_through.tooltip: Bow and trident: hold the draw in the resistance, then press the trigger through it to the bottom to shoot. When off, you shoot by releasing the trigger and the draw resists all the way down.
ds4c.config.group.speaker: Controller speaker
ds4c.config.group.speaker.tooltip: A few sounds that happen in your hands (bows and crossbows, a tool breaking, bundles, books, the spyglass, the level-up chime) play from the DualSense's speaker instead of your speakers or headphones, and pickups get a small echo from the controller. Needs the controller's audio, as for HD haptics.
ds4c.config.speaker_volume.tooltip: How loud the controller speaker plays, on top of the game's own volume settings. 0 keeps every sound on your main speakers or headphones.
ds4c.config.speaker_latency.tooltip: How much later the controller speaker plays than your main audio. Leave at 0 over USB. Raise it if the speaker plays over Bluetooth, so the pickup echo still lands just after the pickup sound.
ds4c.config.effect_gallery.tooltip: Adds the /ds4c gallery commands, which play one trigger effect, grip haptic or game sound at a time so you can feel each on its own. Rejoin a world if the command doesn't show up.
ds4c.gallery.playing_trigger: [DS4C] Playing trigger effect %s for %ss. Touch the controller, then press the trigger.
ds4c.gallery.unknown_trigger: [DS4C] Unknown trigger effect. Press Tab to see the list.
ds4c.gallery.unknown_haptic: [DS4C] Unknown haptic. Press Tab to see the list.
